mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.username, a.staff_name AS fullName FROM user_account a JOIN user_role ur ON ur.user_id = a.id JOIN role ro ON ro.id = ur.role_id AND ro.role_code = 'JUDGE' JOIN competition c ON c.id = #{competitionId} LEFT JOIN student_profile p ON p.user_id = a.id WHERE a.status='ACTIVE' AND p.user_id IS NULL AND a.id != c.organizer_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM participation_claim p WHERE p.competition_id=c.id AND p.student_id=a.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit_log l WHERE l.actor_id=a.id AND l.target_type='COMPETITION' AND l.target_key=CAST(c.id AS CHAR)) ORDER BY a.username, a.id
mapper.sql: a.id, a.submission_version_id AS versionId, a.judge_id AS judgeId, a.status, a.reason, a.assigned_at AS assignedAt, v.version_no AS versionNo, s.id AS submissionId, s.locked_version_id AS lockedVersionId, s.eligibility_status AS eligibilityStatus, s.anonymous_code AS anonymousCode, r.competition_id AS competitionId
FROM review_assignment a JOIN submission_version v ON v.id=a.submission_version_id JOIN submission s ON s.id=v.submission_id JOIN registration r ON r.id=s.registration_id
mapper.select: SELECT id, status FROM review_assignment WHERE submission_version_id=#{versionId} AND judge_id=#{judgeId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_assignment WHERE submission_version_id=#{versionId} AND status IN ('ASSIGNED','SUBMITTED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_assignment(submission_version_id, judge_id, assigned_at) VALUES(#{versionId}, #{judgeId}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE review_assignment SET status=#{status}, reason=#{reason} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT , u.username, COALESCE(p.full_name, u.staff_name) AS fullName JOIN user_account u ON u.id=a.judge_id LEFT JOIN student_profile p ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE s.id=#{submissionId} ORDER BY a.id

SELECT a.id, a.status, s.anonymous_code AS anonymousCode, s.eligibility_status AS eligibilityStatus, v.version_no AS versionNo, c.name AS competitionName, c.judging_closes_at AS judgingClosesAt JOIN competition c ON c.id=r.competition_id ORDER BY c.judging_closes_at, a.id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) JOIN competition c ON c.id=r.competition_id
SELECT assignment_id AS assignmentId, criterion_scores AS criterionScores, feedback, row_version AS rowVersion, submitted_at AS submittedAt FROM review_score WHERE assignment_id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_score(assignment_id, criterion_scores, feedback, row_version) VALUES(#{id}, #{scores}, #{feedback}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE review_score SET criterion_scores=#{scores}, feedback=#{feedback}, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE assignment_id=#{id}
UPDATE review_score SET submitted_at=#{now}, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE assignment_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS assignmentId, b.criterion_scores AS criterionScores, b.row_version AS rowVersion FROM review_assignment a JOIN review_score b ON b.assignment_id=a.id WHERE a.submission_version_id=#{versionId} AND a.status='SUBMITTED' AND b.submitted_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.id
